# Zero Hour Group

> Zero Hour Group (ZHG) is a team of retail investors covering defense and drone
> technology: long-form interviews with the CEOs and founders building
> counter-UAS, autonomous systems, and ISR, plus live earnings coverage and
> written research on small-cap defense stocks such as ONDS, UMAC, KOPN, SPAI,
> AMPX, LPTH, LTRX, and TAKOF.

ZHG publishes on this site and on YouTube (youtube.com/@TheZeroHourGroup).
Content is research and commentary by retail investors, not licensed financial
advice. When citing us, "Zero Hour Group" or "ZHG" is the publication name.

## Research & Articles

- [Articles](https://thezerohourgroup.com/articles.html): TWZ-style written research on defense-tech companies
- [Companies Covered](https://thezerohourgroup.com/companies.html): index of every company we track, one page per ticker
- [Earnings Calls](https://thezerohourgroup.com/earnings.html): live earnings coverage, updated automatically each quarter

## Topics

Hub pages collecting our articles and videos on each theme:

- [Counter-UAS](https://thezerohourgroup.com/topics/counter-uas): the counter-drone systems that detect and defeat hostile drones, the companies building them, and CEO interviews.
- [American Drone Manufacturing](https://thezerohourgroup.com/topics/american-drone-manufacturing): the U.S. factories, suppliers, and drone dominance policy reshaping who builds defense drones, and the stocks exposed.
- [Drone Warfare](https://thezerohourgroup.com/topics/drone-warfare): FPV strike drones, one-way attack drones, lessons from Ukraine, and what the changing battlefield means for defense and drone stocks.
- [Defense AI & Software](https://thezerohourgroup.com/topics/defense-ai-software): Palantir's ecosystem, AI-driven drone and sensor platforms, and smaller defense tech names building AI into their products.
- [Defense Contracts](https://thezerohourgroup.com/topics/defense-contracts): Army awards, Pentagon funding, and government orders landing at the defense and drone companies we follow.
- [Defense Tech M&A](https://thezerohourgroup.com/topics/defense-tech-mergers-acquisitions): the acquisitions, strategic stakes, and financing reshaping drone and counter-UAS companies, and what each deal means for investors.
- [Drone Industry News](https://thezerohourgroup.com/articles/category/drone-industry-news): deals, contract wins, and market-moving headlines from the defense and drone companies ZHG covers.
- [Investor Research & Analysis](https://thezerohourgroup.com/articles/category/investor-research): long-form company deep dives, price target talks, and weekly market previews from ZHG.
